description: Advisory file-churn budget for one common-develop iteration or commit.

rules.derivedProjectionStorage: Ignored current_manifest.json and current_impact.json only; tracked projection budget is zero.
rules.handoffHistory: Create dated handoff only when crossing a phase, external team, or resumable ownership boundary; same-phase revision history belongs in attempt, StageOutcome, and work_record.
rules.changeRequestCoalescing: Before downstream analysis starts, consecutive clarifications update one stable Change Request ID and increment its revision.
rules.phaseOwnedDocuments: A phase may update its owned canonical facts; downstream design/plan/project summaries are marked stale and regenerated by their owner phase.
